remaining: Physical plug/latch seating and hand access; the receiving housing is catalogue outline, not detailed female latch CAD.
Flexible joint motion, snag risk and actual slack dressing with the assembled robot; no rigid sweep of the whole neutral soft loop is prescribed.
Existing original ankle bare-motor/fork and lower-link physical fitting boundaries remain in the mechanical guide; cable delta checks do not supersede them.
Strand slot/colour is geometric only; confirm manufacturer keyed electrical pin assignment before applying power.

assemblyInstructions.prepare: With power disconnected, identify motor IDs 2/7 and the registered socket. Preinsert this cable end before seating the knee motor into the orange thigh. Keep the cable free, not trapped under the motor or reinforcing plate.
assemblyInstructions.check: Full plug receiving body carried with knee motor along mirrored 45 mm guide approaches is clear against thigh and neighbouring motor bounds at 0.25 mm samples.

assemblyInstructions.prepare: Preinsert the other cable end in motor IDs 1/6 before putting that motor into the loose ankle fork. Feed the free soft length through the open side; keep the lower link and retaining screws off.
assemblyInstructions.check: Added plug body carried with motor from +Z30 into ankle/sleeve is sampled clear at 0.25 mm. This does not erase the existing bare-motor/fork source-contact fit boundary.

assemblyInstructions.prepare: Arrange the source exit towards the central thigh opening, then turn inboard before descending past the lip. Arrange the ankle return beside the lower-link end. Keep the 180 mm surplus as an accessible soft loop while joining the lower module; close retention only after checking both wire exits.
assemblyInstructions.check: Observe all three conductors clear of the lower rod, thigh lip, fastener seats and linkage. Do not pull tight or force the visual loop into an exact rigid shape.

assemblyInstructions.prepare: The ordinary 15 mm straight insertion path is blocked by thigh at the knee and ankle/lower link at the ankle. Do not push a plug through those solids or remove the unrelated black reinforcing plate as a presumed remedy. If not prewired, reopen only the corresponding original motor/fork retention to return to the above preconnection stages; no new printed part is required.
assemblyInstructions.check: This report does not certify a shorter tilted recovery insertion or unchanged fully assembled access.

acceptanceScope: Native readback of the frozen local neutral geometry only; source static/self/preconnection receipts remain separate. Whole harness and flexible articulation not accepted.
